title: 8-Bit S-Boxes with Vectorial Linearity Below 14
summary: For 8-bit S-boxes, the proven lower bound is 10 and a reported example has exact vectorial linearity 15; it remains open whether a value below 14 exists.

formal_statement.body: For an 8-bit S-box, determine whether there exists a function whose vectorial linearity is lower than 14; the required resolution is either an explicit construction of such an S-box or a proof that no such 8-bit S-box exists. The available evidence reports a proven lower bound of 10 for $n=8$ and an 8-bit function $S=S^{15}$ with exact vectorial linearity 15; the existence or nonexistence of an 8-bit S-box with vectorial linearity lower than 14 remains unresolved.

scope.domain: Structural and existence questions for vectorial Boolean functions used as S-boxes in symmetric cryptography.
parameters: 8-bit S-box dimension: fixes the function size
10: reported proven lower bound for n = 8
15: exact vectorial linearity of the reported function S = S^15
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether an 8-bit S-box with vectorial linearity below 14 exists, by constructing one or proving that none exists.

citations.label: Algorithmic Toolkit for Linearization of S-boxes

progress.summary: The source reports exact vectorial linearity 15 for the function S = S^15 and recalls a proven lower bound of 10 for n = 8. It explicitly presents finding an 8-bit S-box below 14, or proving none exists, as a challenging open problem.
